result.summary: The pedestrian environment features continuous sidewalks but lacks high-visibility crossing infrastructure at the intersection. A large parked vehicle near the corner creates a significant sightline obstruction between pedestrians and approaching traffic.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large black pickup truck is parked very close to the intersection, blocking the view between pedestrians on the corner and oncoming drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no high-visibility markings to designate where pedestrians should cross the wide roadway.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the intersection to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian paths.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and further improve sightlines by preventing illegal parking at the corner.

result.summary: The image shows a typical residential street with a continuous, well-maintained sidewalk separated from the roadway by a grass buffer. While the pedestrian walkway is clear, the presence of large parked vehicles creates visual obstructions, and there is a lack of visible traffic calming or crossing infrastructure in this mid-block section.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: The large black pickup truck parked at the curb blocks the line of sight between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers on the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground, parked along the curb

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) at the nearest intersection or potential mid-block crossing to improve visibility and reduce crossing distance.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to ensure visibility and safety for pedestrians during nighttime hours, as no luminaires are visible.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming measures like speed humps to maintain low vehicle speeds in this residential environment.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with sidewalks on both sides, though only the left side features a grass buffer. The roadway is wide and lacks lane markings or traffic calming measures, which may encourage higher vehicle speeds in a pedestrian-oriented area.

hazards.name: Wide unmarked roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a wide street can lead to higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable positioning.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb can hide pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement speed humps to physically slow traffic to speeds appropriate for a residential street.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility marked crosswalks to designate safe places for pedestrians to cross.

result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or traffic signals, despite having continuous sidewalks and grass buffers. The wide roadway and lack of traffic calming measures likely encourage higher vehicle speeds in this residential setting.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection to define pedestrian right-of-way or alert drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground at the intersection of the two streets

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radius
hazards.description: The curb radius at the corner is wide, which allows vehicles to make turns at higher speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: The corner curb in the center foreground

hazards.name: Lack of Tactile Warnings
hazards.description: The existing curb ramp lacks detectable warning surfaces (truncated domes) for visually impaired pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: The curb ramp at the corner in the center foreground

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks across all legs of the intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing curb ramp to include detectable warning surfaces and ensure proper alignment with crossings.
